title: Feasibility study of renewable energy-based microgrid system in Somaliland׳s urban centers

title: Assessment of wind energy resource in the western region of Somaliland
geographic_scope: Aburin, Daarbuduq and Xumba Weyne, western Somaliland
method: Hourly station measurements, gap filling, Weibull fitting and turbine/economic simulations.
data_sources: FAO-SWALIM wind speed/direction at 10 m; commercial turbine curves.
key_findings: Site differences matter; Xumba Weyne has the strongest modeled wind potential among the three.
limitations: One old measurement year; gap-filled observations and extrapolated hub heights. Power-density unit labels conflict; Table 11 AEP/CF/rated-power combinations do not reconcile with Eq33.
project_relevance: Locate original SWALIM series and quality-control masks for resource validation.
verification_locator: Measured-data section/Table1; Tables2,5–11 and Eq33; Data availability and corresponding-author note in primary JATS XML.
quality_appraisal: Useful station-data lead; published turbine-energy and economic outputs need clarification and independent recomputation.
data_code_availability: Authors explicitly offer data on request. No downloadable raw series or code package verified; corresponding author Mohamed Jama, see RQ02.
